passport.title: Brasília
passport.insideText: A little guide to our city, for everyone travelling from afar to celebrate with us.

tourism.title: Sightseeing
tourism.intro: Niemeyer and Lúcio Costa's modernist capital: monuments, lookouts and the huge cerrado sky. Our favourite places to explore, for anyone who wants to spend a few days enjoying the city.

restaurants.title: Restaurants
restaurants.intro: Our pick of favourite places to eat in Brasília. Every time we come back, we try to get to as many of them as we can.

transport.title: Getting Around
transport.intro: Brasília is big and spread out. These are the best ways to arrive and get around the city.

hotels.title: Where to Stay
hotels.intro: A few suggestions of where to stay, close to the center and to everything worth seeing, with easy access to the wedding.
